name: Ataeric: On Arcane Curiosities

angles.text: Mages have an innate interest in arcane research, making contributions to scholarly libraries and the recovery of magical treatises directly relevant to their craft.
Dwarven scholars and the Explorers' League place great value on accumulating written records, artifacts, and esoteric lore.

faq.answer: Ataeric: On Arcane Curiosities represents the delivery of a scholarly or magical text to a collector seeking to expand a library's repository of esoteric knowledge.
faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?

faq.answer: Ataeric is the author of the treatise. It is turned in to a researcher or curator gathering magical works and rare volumes to enrich a library's archives.
The text is sought to enhance an academic collection, benefiting the scholarly library that takes the work in.
faq.q: Which library benefits from these curiosities?

faq.answer: The scholar specifically encourages adventurers to bring forward any additional magical works discovered during their travels to continually broaden their store of lore.
faq.q: Are there more magical works to collect?

faq.answer: Scholars continually look for rare treatises to better understand the nuances of the arcane and preserve historical, mystical knowledge.
faq.q: Why does the library seek arcane curiosities?

faq.answer: Arcane texts often contain volatile or obscure knowledge, making their safekeeping and study within a dedicated library preferable to leaving them lost in the field.
faq.q: Why is recovering arcane works important?

sections.body: Scholars and archivists across Azeroth rely on wandering adventurers to recover rare tomes and forgotten treatises from dangerous ground. In this task, an inquirer seeks magical writings specifically to broaden an institution's understanding of the arcane arts. Every volume recovered helps piece together mystical practices that might otherwise remain scattered or lost.
sections.title: Preserving Arcane Knowledge

sections.body: Upon receiving the curiosities, the curator incorporates them directly into the archive's repository. Rather than viewing the acquisition as complete, the library maintains an open call for any further magical writings uncovered across the world, ensuring their collection continues to grow alongside ongoing scholarship.
sections.title: An Expanding Archive

summary: Ataeric: On Arcane Curiosities involves delivering recovered magical writings to expand a scholarly archive's collection. By gathering obscure texts and treatises from the field, researchers seek to deepen their understanding of arcane studies and preserve mystical lore.
